Wire: to (signal).description: Render a signal's value as escaped text

Wire: expression.description: Render an expression, updating when the listed signals change

Wire: unescaped markup.description: Render markup your own code generated, unescaped

Wire: once.description: Render a template once, with no signals

Wire: with (template).description: Re-render a template when signals change (space separated for several)

Wire: for (list).description: Render a template per list item

Wire: for (expression).description: Render a template per item of an expression's array

Wire: else if.description: Render when the previous if was false and this condition holds

Wire: else.description: Render when the previous if / else if was false

Wire: component (instance).description: Instantiate a component (argument: @signal, @{ expr } or literal)

Wire: listen.description: Add a listener, stop() removes it
